title: avoid reset clear
rule: Avoid Reset and Clear on web forms; if Cancel is needed for sensitive data, give it much less prominence than Submit.
pass_when: No form-wide Reset/Clear; if Cancel exists for sensitive data, it is visually weaker than Submit.
fail_when: Reset/Clear wipes the form, or Cancel equals/competes with Submit.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
